title: A payer's contact can be saved as Authorizer and prints on the estimate
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with two contacts, contact B1 and contact B2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B, with one line, so the estimate has something to print.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Authorizer field.
  4. Pick contact B1.
  5. Reload the page.
  6. Open the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • Contact B1 is in the list, with customer B's name on its second line.

Step 4:

  • Authorizer shows contact B1.

Step 5:

  • After the reload, Authorizer still shows contact B1.

Step 6:

  • The estimate on the Finance tab names contact B1 as the authorizer.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
